m4_3_identity.description: M4-3 complete authorization-bound idempotency identity: same key + same complete semantics = replay; same key + changed authorization semantics = conflict; derived from actual mutation context driving request bindings, not lease-copied bindings
components: authorization fingerprint (principal, contract_hash, Subject+raw preconditions, approval/Decision basis, expiry, mutation_scope)

external_journal_identity.description: External mutation journal identity reuses M4-3 authorization-bound identity and extends it with deterministic external linkage fields
components: intent_fingerprint (semantic inputs only, excluding trusted data)
authorization fingerprint (principal, lease/attempt reference, approval/Decision basis where required, expiry)
subject_expected_revision (Subject CAS precondition at PREPARED time)

linkage.M4_3_idempotency_identity_vs_external_jo: M4-3 SubjectTransaction idempotency lookup key is (idempotency_key, operation, target, principal, intent_fingerprint) with authorization drift detection; external journal identity persists the same plus external preconditions and candidate digest so that a replayed journal entry and a replayed SubjectTransaction converge on the same conflict/replay classification
linkage.journal_attempt_identity: One journal record may own at most one external attempt (APPLYING → at most one external call); duplicate executor attempts for same journal/idempotency identity are reservation-gated: single external apply eligibility, ownership/lease semantics enforce mutual exclusion; recovery takeover reads stranded APPLYING before any new attempt
linkage.fallback_denied: MutationIntent.intent_fingerprint only is insufficient; full authorization-bound identity is required
linkage.same_key_changed_authorization: must never become automatic replay; always CONFLICT with no effect

external_operation_attempt_identity.description: One APPLYING record corresponds to exactly one bounded lease/attempt; RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT requires a new attempt identity with fresh authorization
